description:
FOUND (s526w1, YAML-Tiny census: t/32_world_tml.t / 30_yaml_spec_tml.t subtests ran NO rows -- TestML::Tiny::_slurp is `open ...; local $/; <$fh>;` and read 185 of 397 characters).
Probe (scratch p-rs3.pl, file "a\n\nb\n\nc\n"):
  open my $a, "<", F; my @a = do { local $/; <$a> };            # perl 1 record, PCL 3
  { local $/ = undef; my @b = <$b>; }                              # 1 in both
  my $s = do { local $/; <$c> };                                   # perl length 8, PCL 3
base main 706cfde8 = the tree before the fix (1 3 3).
CAUSE: `local $/;` lowers to `(let (($/ (make-p-box nil))) ...)` -- a box holding NIL, which is undef everywhere else (%pcl-definedp) -- but cl/pcl-runtime.lisp get-input-record-separator tested only `(eq val *p-undef*)` and sent NIL to `(to-string val)` = "" = paragraph mode.
FIX (s526w1 filler, one line): `((or (null val) (eq val *p-undef*)) nil)`.  Guard Pl/t/fileio-02.t row 46 (perl oracle).  The slurp idiom is everywhere; only files with blank lines showed it.

DONE (s526w1): fixed as described; bars (full sweep, YAML-Tiny re-run) in the s526w1 report.
